top_signals.title: Global Bonds Are Reeling as Oil Surge Rekindles Inflation Threat
top_signals.summary: Global bonds were pummeled this week by the latest resurgence in energy prices, delivering losses to investors who bet the worst of this year’s rout was over and teeing up credibility tests for central bankers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: A quantum roadmap would push Bitcoin much higher: Charles Edwards
top_signals.summary: A Bitcoin development roadmap that addresses quantum computing risks could see the price surge by “double digits” very quickly, according to Charles Edwards.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Intel's rides AI boom to fastest revenue growth in almost 15 years, but shares sink
top_signals.summary: Intel's revenue jumped 25%, the most robust growth for any period since the third quarter of 2011.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
